title: Drone strikes warehouse in southern Russia, online retailer Ozon claims
summary: A drone struck a logistics center belonging to Russian online retail giant Ozon in southern Russia's Adygea Republic overnight on Nov. 4, the company claimed in a press release.

title: New Jersey governor warns importing Russian diesel 'will be met with harsh penalties' amid Trump deal
summary: "Any effort to profit from the illegal trade in Russian fuel will be met with harsh penalties. I urge you to turn away any tanker that seeks to use your facilities in furtherance of such unlawful activity," New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill wrote to ports in the state.

title: Death toll from Russian attack on Komyshuvakha rises to 37 as search operation enters 3rd day
summary: As of the morning of Nov. 4, 59 people were considered missing, local authorities said.

title: Moldova outpaces Ukraine on new EU membership roadmap
summary: Ukraine and Moldova are both expected to make strides toward EU membership next year, even as Chisinau outpaces Kyiv on reforms.

title: EU says Ukraine must speed up rule of law reforms to meet accession goals
summary: The EU has committed to supporting Ukraine's goal of closing accession talks by the end of 2028, but says reforms must accelerate to meet that objective.

title: Russian attacks kill 6, injure 50 across Ukraine over past day, as energy facilities targeted in multiple regions
summary: Russian forces continued to target the energy infrastructure of Ukraine over the past day, including Odesa, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr, western Ternopil, Volyn, and Rivne oblasts, the local authorities said on Oct. 4.

title: Ukraine's anti-graft agencies probe possible SBU role in high-profile case, report firearm threats during searches
summary: NABU and SAPO said they had uncovered a criminal organization accused of "systematically bribing" senior law enforcement officials to secure protection for scam call centers and other illegal businesses.

title: And still, they plant: Ukraine's front-line farmers rebuild their businesses against all odds

title: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Ukraine's Order of Princess Olga for humanitarian work
summary: The decree credited Melania Trump with a "significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine."

title: Democrats seize control of Congress in blow to Trump, potential boost for Ukraine
summary: The Associated Press projected that Democrats had won control of the Senate, while NBC News projected a Democratic victory in the House of Representatives. Vote counting remained underway in several congressional races.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,597,010 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,180 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Ukrainian-born US lawmaker Victoria Spartz loses congressional seat to Democrat
summary: In April 2025, Spartz said Ukraine should cede territory to Russia and called for Zelensky's resignation.

title: Canada to block Russian team from World Junior Hockey Championship, Carney says
summary: The Canadian government said it would use its authority under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act to prevent Russian and Belarusian athletes and officials from entering Canada to compete under their national symbols.
